meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能从 H&E 组织切片图像预测空间基因表达:输入 224x224、约 20x 的图像块,按 HGNC 基因符号查询约 1.9 万蛋白编码基因面板,输出 log1p-CPM 数值,并按原图像块网格排列成虚拟空间转录组图谱。
howto.when: 当你需要约 20x、224x224 的 H&E 图像块的空间基因表达,或想按基因符号查询约 1.9 万基因面板,或在用 histolab 切块后对整张切片跑预测时触发。

say.text: 把整张切片的图像块批量跑预测,拼成图像块×基因的矩阵
say.note: 矩阵可直接转成 AnnData 做下游分析

say.text: 换 source=orthrus 对同一批图像块再跑一遍,比较结果
say.note: 每次运行只能选一种嵌入来源

howto.what_en: Installs a model that predicts spatial gene expression from H&E histology: it takes 224x224 tiles at about 20x, queries protein-coding genes by HGNC symbol, and returns log1p-CPM values on the tile grid.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need spatial expression for 224x224 H&E tiles at about 20x, want to query genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or run prediction across a whole slide after histolab tiling.

say_en.text: Predict EPCAM and CD3D for this 224x224 H&E tile with DeepSpotM
say_en.note: Values return in log1p-CPM, aligned to your gene list

say_en.text: Run whole-slide prediction in batches and assemble a tiles-by-genes matrix
say_en.note: Drops into AnnData for downstream spatial analysis

say_en.text: Rerun the same tiles with source=orthrus and compare the results
